data.indexFullNameCn: 中证全指保险行业指数
data.indexFullNameEn: CSI All Share Insurance Industry Index
data.indexCnDesc: 中证全指行业优选指数系列从中证全指行业中选取符合一定流动性与市值筛选条件的上市公司作为指数样本，以反映各个行业内较具代表性与可投资性的上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: The CSI All Share Industry Select Indices selects securities from corresponding CSI Sectors that satisfy certain liquidity and market capitalization standard as index constituents, to reflect the overall performance of representative and investable securities within each CSI sector.
